50719-juju.title: Juju
50719-juju.creator: Unknown
50719-juju.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The tall, dank tree trunks loomed mysteriously above the band of vociferous natives, with their thumping, rumbling, booming drums sounding hollowly from the front of the procession. The lights wound into the forest, deep into the unknown and unknowable bush. The yelling became fainter, but the drums continued to boom out monotonously through the throbbing silence of the African night.

78650-the-framed-fifty.title: The Framed Fifty
78650-the-framed-fifty.creator: Unknown
78650-the-framed-fifty.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Rare good fortune was his when it fell to his lot to locate on a Broadway corner in the Thirties, when that section was the very heart and center of New York and the Tenderloin police station the busiest in the world.

arxiv-2011-14945.title: Zero- to ultralow-field nuclear magnetic resonance and its applications
arxiv-2011-14945.creator: Min Jiang, Ji Bian, Qing Li, Ze Wu, Haowen Su, Minxiang Xu, Yuanhong Wang, Xin Wang, Xinhua Peng
arxiv-2011-14945.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Min Jiang, Ji Bian, Qing Li, Ze Wu, Haowen Su, Minxiang Xu, Yuanhong Wang, Xin Wang, Xinhua Peng. As a complementary analysis tool to conventional high-field NMR, zero- to ultralow-field (ZULF) NMR detects nuclear magnetization signals in the sub-microtesla regime. Spin-exchange relaxation-free (SERF) atomic magnetometers provide a new generation of sensitive detector for ZULF NMR. Due to the features such as low-cost, high-resolution and potability, ZULF NMR has recently attracted considerable attention in chemistry, biology, medicine, and tests of fundamental physics.

arxiv-2105-07352.title: Numerical Modeling of Kondratyev’s Long Waves Taking into Account Heredity
arxiv-2105-07352.creator: Makarov Danil, Parovik Roman
arxiv-2105-07352.description: Abstract The paper proposes a new mathematical model of economic cycles and crises, which generalizes the well-known model of Dubovsky S.V. The novelty of the proposed model lies in taking into account the effect of heredity (memory), as well as the introduction of harmonic functions responsible for the arrival of investments in fixed assets and new management technologies in innovation.

arxiv-2302-08846.title: Mixed ℋ 2 / ℋ ∞ \mathcal{H}_{2}/\mathcal{H}_{\infty} -Policy Learning Synthesis The author is with Microsoft Research, NYC.
arxiv-2302-08846.creator: Lekan Molu
arxiv-2302-08846.description: Abstract A robustly stabilizing optimal control policy in a model-free mixed ℋ 2 / ℋ ∞ \mathcal{H}_{2}/\mathcal{H}_{\infty} -control setting is here put forward for counterbalancing the slow convergence and non-robustness of traditional high-variance policy optimization (and by extension policy gradient) algorithms.

arxiv-2305-15061.title: Assortative and preferential attachment lead to core-periphery networks
arxiv-2305-15061.creator: Javier Ureña-Carrion, Fariba Karimi, Gerardo Iñiguez, Mikko Kivelä
arxiv-2305-15061.description: Abstract Core-periphery is a key feature of large-scale networks underlying a wide range of social, biological, and transportation phenomena. Nodes in the core have an influential position in the network, and thus the periphery can be under structural disadvantage if the groups are aligned with external attributes such as gender or economic status.

arxiv-2407-17471.title: Real-Time Automated donning and doffing detection of PPE based on Yolov4-tiny Thanks: 2 These authors contributed equally to this work
arxiv-2407-17471.creator: 1 st Anusha Verma, 2 nd Ghazal Ghajari, 3 rd K M Tawsik Jawad, 4 th Dr. Hugh P. Salehi, 5 th Dr. Fathi Amsaad
arxiv-2407-17471.description: Abstract Maintaining patient safety and the safety of healthcare workers (HCWs) in hospitals and clinics highly depends on following the proper protocol for donning and taking off personal protective equipment (PPE). HCWs can benefit from a feedback system during the putting on and removal process because the process is cognitively demanding and errors are common.

arxiv-2501-10046.title: Neutrinoless double-beta decay search with the LEGEND experiment
arxiv-2501-10046.creator: R. Brugnera
arxiv-2501-10046.description: Abstract Neutrinoless double-beta decay is a nuclear decay, given as ( A , Z ) → ( A , Z + 2 ) + 2 ​ e − (A,Z)\rightarrow(A,Z+2)+2e^{-} , with deep consequences for the understanding of our universe. A strong experimental program is underway to search for this transition with many proposed experiments using different technologies.

arxiv-2504-20651.title: Learning and Generalization with Mixture Data
arxiv-2504-20651.creator: Harsh Vardhan, Avishek Ghosh, Arya Mazumdar
arxiv-2504-20651.description: Abstract In many, if not most, machine learning applications the training data is naturally heterogeneous (e.g. federated learning, adversarial attacks and domain adaptation in neural net training). Data heterogeneity is identified as one of the major challenges in modern day large-scale learning. A classical way to represent heterogeneous data is via a mixture model.

arxiv-2511-10823.title: Beating Meet-in-the-Middle for Subset Balancing Problems
arxiv-2511-10823.creator: Tim Randolph, Karol Węgrzycki
arxiv-2511-10823.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tim Randolph, Karol Węgrzycki. We consider exact algorithms for Subset Balancing, a family of related problems that generalizes Subset Sum, Partition, and Equal Subset Sum. Specifically, given as input an integer vector x → ∈ ℤ n \vec{x}\in\mathbb{Z}^{n} and a constant-size coefficient set C ⊂ ℤ C\subset\mathbb{Z} , we seek a nonzero solution vector c → ∈ C n \vec{c}\in C^{n} satisfying c → ⋅ x → = 0 \vec{c}\cdot\vec{x}=0 .

arxiv-2512-02795.title: Towards Observation Lakehouses: Living, Interactive Archives of Software Behavior
arxiv-2512-02795.creator: Marcus Kessel
arxiv-2512-02795.description: Abstract Code-generating LLMs are trained largely on static artifacts (source, comments, specifications) and rarely on materializations of run‑time behavior. As a result, they readily internalize buggy or mislabeled code. Since non‑trivial semantic properties are undecidable in general, the only practical way to obtain ground-truth functionality is by dynamic observation of executions.

arxiv-2601-17651.title: Higher order double point formulas via SSM–Thom polynomials
arxiv-2601-17651.creator: Reese Lance
arxiv-2601-17651.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Reese Lance. We study the geometry of double point loci of maps F : M → N F:M\to N of complex manifolds through the lens of Segre–Schwartz–MacPherson (SSM) classes. Classical double point formulas express the fundamental class of the closure of the double point locus of F F in terms of global invariants of source and target spaces, as well as F F .

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adoration.creator: William L Sullivan
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adoration.description: Article 'Adoration' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10544383.title: Wealth-based inequality in the continuum of maternal health service utilisation in 16 sub-Saharan African countries
pmc-10544383.creator: Anteneh Asefa, Samson Gebremedhin, Tiara Marthias, Herfina Nababan, Aliki Christou, Aline Semaan, Aduragbemi Banke-Thomas, Hanani Tabana, Fadhlun M. Alwy Al-beity, Jean-Paul Dossou, Keneni Gutema, Thérèse Delvaux, Catherine Birabwa, Mardieh Dennis, Fassou Mathias Grovogui, Barbara McPake, Lenka Beňo
pmc-10544383.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundPersistent inequalities in coverage of maternal health services in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), a region home to two-thirds of global maternal deaths in 2017, poses a challenge for countries to achieve the Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) targets.

pmc-10595095.title: Smartphone Addiction among Syrian Medical Students
pmc-10595095.creator: H Alibrahim, H Bohsas, S Swed, B Abou Shaar, K Albakri, H Haj Saleh, B Sawaf, A Bakkour, W Hafez, I Cherrez-Ojeda
pmc-10595095.description: BackgroundSmartphone use has increased and has become an essential part of daily life. This study aimed to assess the prevalence of smartphone addiction among medical students in Syria, investigate its potential effects on insomnia and sub-health.MethodsThis study was conducted in Syria from October 6th to November 12th, 2022. We included Syrian medical students across all Syrian medical colleges.

pmc-10748312.title: Brief Myofascial Intervention Modulates Visual Event-Related Potential Response to Emotional Photographic Contents: A Pilot Study
pmc-10748312.creator: Gabriel Byczynski, Amedeo D’Angiulli
pmc-10748312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The use of touch for the treatment of psychiatric disorders is increasingly investigated, as it is shown that cognitive symptoms can be improved by various forms of massage. To investigate if the effect of massage is measurable using classical visual event-related potential components (P1, P2, late positive potential (LPP)), we performed a preliminary study on six participants using myofascial induction massage. Participants were shown emotionally valenced or neutral images before and after a 20 min myofascial massage.

pmc-11343756.title: MEF2B C-terminal mutations enhance transcriptional activity and stability to drive B cell lymphomagenesis
pmc-11343756.creator: Chuanjiang Yu, Qiong Shen, Antony B. Holmes, Tongwei Mo, Anna Tosato, Rajesh Kumar Soni, Clarissa Corinaldesi, Sanjay Koul, Laura Pasqualucci, Shafinaz Hussein, Farhad Forouhar, Riccardo Dalla-Favera, Katia Basso
pmc-11343756.description: The myocyte enhancer factor 2B (MEF2B) transcription factor is frequently mutated in germinal center (GC)-derived B-cell lymphomas. Its ammino (N)-terminal mutations drive lymphomagenesis by escaping interaction with transcriptional repressors, while the function of carboxy (C)-terminal mutations remains to be elucidated.

pmc-11410061.title: Transverse Sinus Stenosis as an Underdiagnosed Cause of Chronic Headache: A Case Report
pmc-11410061.creator: Marina Handal, RaeAnn Tourangeau-Young, Alejandro Biglione
pmc-11410061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Transverse sinus stenosis (TSS) is an abnormality in the cerebral venous system in which the narrowing of the transverse sinus of the brain leads to obstructed cerebral venous outflow. It is an infrequent, incidental radiological finding. However, it is not uncommon among patients with chronic headaches of unclear cause, particularly those that remain unexplained after initial evaluation or those that are refractory to medical treatment.

pmc-11518084.title: A global adoption of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology into the healthcare system
pmc-11518084.creator: J Johnson, B Berkshire
pmc-11518084.description: Background/ObjectivesBlockchain technology is revolutionizing various industries by enhancing security, transparency, and efficiency. In healthcare, its small-scale application demonstrates the potential to transform healthcare. This study explores how cryptocurrency and blockchain technology enhance healthcare financial stability, secure medical information exchange, increase payment recovery and interoperability.

pmc-11590031.title: Comparison of serum zinc levels between patients with sinonasal neutrophilic and eosinophilic inflammatory polyposis and healthy individuals
pmc-11590031.creator: Matin Ghazizadeh, Elahe Roshanaie, Behrouz Barati
pmc-11590031.description: ObjectivesSome changes in nasal mucus and paranasal sinuses may occur due to zinc deficiency, which can cause chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP). The current study was designed to compare the serum zinc concentration between patients with chronic rhinosinusitis complicated with eosinophilic or neutrophilic nasal polyps and a control group.MethodsA total of 105 patients participated in the study.

pmc-12657173.title: Circ_0060927 regulates miR-331-3p/ERK/MAPK pathway reaction in non-small cell lung cancer through METTL14-driven methylation
pmc-12657173.creator: Yang Liao, Ji Song, Chun Luo, Jin Xiang, Sheng Cheng
pmc-12657173.description: BackgroundNon-coding RNA is one of the most paramount genetic regulators. circRNAs (Circular RNAs) are a potential modulator of various tumors, especially in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This study focused on elucidating the underlying influence of circ_0060927 on NSCLC progression and relevant regulatory mechanisms.MethodsManipulating circ_0060927, MAP2K7, and METTL14 expression in NSCLC cells by lentiviral vectors.

pmc-12881716.title: Evaluation of Micronucleus Count in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma (OSCC) Newly Diagnosed Patients Compared to Previously Treated Ones: A Cytologic Study
pmc-12881716.creator: Marjan Mohammadi, Noushin Jalayer Naderi, Ata Garajei, Seyed Masoud Sajedi
pmc-12881716.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEarly detection and monitoring of genomic damages are vital for improving therapeutic outcomes. Quantification of micronuclei in exfoliated buccal mucosa cells has emerged as a reliable biomarker for assessing genomic alterations and cytogenetic damage in precancerous and cancerous conditions. Materials and MethodsThis study evaluated exfoliated buccal cells from two groups of OSCC patients: seventeen newly diagnosed individuals who hadn’t yet undergone OSCC treatments and seventeen patients assessed at least six months after treatments.

pmc-12967272.title: A variational framework for residual-based adaptivity in neural PDE solvers and operator learning
pmc-12967272.creator: Juan Diego Toscano, Daniel T Chen, Vivek Ooomen, Jérôme Darbon, George Em Karniadakis
pmc-12967272.description: Residual-based adaptive strategies are widely used in scientific machine learning yet remain largely heuristic. We introduce a variational framework that formalizes these methods through convex transformations of the residual, where different transformations correspond to distinct objective functionals. For instance, exponential weights target uniform error minimization, while linear weights recover quadratic error minimization.

pmc-13265050.title: Strategies for engineering domesticated and undomesticated human microbes
pmc-13265050.creator: Dake Liu, Meng-Lun Hsieh, Yousong Ding
pmc-13265050.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Human-associated microbes hold immense therapeutic potential, yet most species remain undomesticated due to cultivation barriers and limited genetic tools. Recent advances in genetic engineering are overcoming these challenges, enabling the precise manipulation of both domesticated and previously intractable microbes. This review highlights established strategies for engineering domesticated strains, such as Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 and lactic acid bacteria, for diverse therapeutic applications.

pmc-13316316.title: Cardioplegia practices in pediatric cardiovascular surgery: Survey across Asia, Europe, and North America
pmc-13316316.creator: Robert X. Lao, Cristina Salvo, Anamaria Stanisic, Osami Honjo
pmc-13316316.description: BackgroundCardioplegia and myocardial protection strategies continue to evolve, with wide variation in reported practices. However, there is no contemporary report of these practices in pediatrics. We conducted a survey of pediatric cardioplegia practice among major institutions across Asia, Europe, and North America.

pmc-13434119.title: Modular lab-on-chip platform with integrated a-Si:H sensors for real-time bioluminescence monitoring in bioreactors under microgravity conditions
pmc-13434119.creator: Lorenzo Nardi, Dirk Jonker, Vahid Omrani, Parsa Abbasrezaee, Sahithi Sriramoju, Emani Venkata Sai Siva Sankam, Domenico Caputo, Nicola Lovecchio, Giulia Petrucci, Alessio Di Serafino, Francesca Costantini, Donato Calabria, Elisa Lazzarini, Han Gardeniers, Mara Mirasoli, Augusto Nascetti
pmc-13434119.description: Long-term deep space missions present critical health challenges due to prolonged exposure to space radiation and microgravity, leading to significant physiological risks for astronauts. Galactic cosmic rays, in particular, can penetrate conventional shielding and produce harmful secondary particles, emphasizing the need for innovative in-situ solutions to study the effects of these environmental conditions on astronauts’ health and mitigate the risks.

pmc-13510657.creator: Logan T. Trujillo
